items.title: Bangladesh garment workers protesting for higher wages clash with police
items.summary: Thousands of Bangladeshi garment workers blocked a major highway and clashed with police on Monday, demanding a monthly minimum wage more than double their current pay, as protests spread across industrial hubs.
